decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of planning permission PL/0565/23 dated 01/07/2024.

The windows and roof lights in the side elevations of the proposed development shall:
(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.

The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development shall be in accordance with those shown in the elevations and application form hereby approved, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

This permission shall have the effect of varying condition numbered 2 on approved application reference PL/0565/23 dated 01/07/2024. The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: Cover Letter (Re: Minor-Material Amendment to Planning Permission ref. PL/0565/23 - 29 Elms Road, Harrow Weald, HA3 6BB), Planning Application Supporting Statement, Design and Access Statement, PA-2508-00, PA-2508-01, PA-2508-02, PA-2508-03, PA-2508-04, PA-2508-05, PA-2508-06, PA-2508-07, PA-2508-08, PA-2508-09, PA-2508-10, 02, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09.

<p>Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.</p>
description: Variation of Condition 2 (approved plans) and Condition 3 (materials) attached to planning permission PL/0565/23 dated 1.7.2024 to allow changes to the approved plans and materials
